relations.order-causation: Order asserts causation: putting B after A proposes that A explains B, though no sentence says so.
relations.dangling-premise: A cut premise leaves its conclusion standing: a surviving sentence refers to something no longer in the piece.
relations.synonym-repetition: Repetition in synonyms mistaken for emphasis: restatements that add no new register, only another word for the last one.
relations.foreign-passage: A passage answering a question the piece never asked.

limits: defects a human caught, not defects that shipped unnoticed
several commits fix more than one thing (see also_fixed)
a negative for one relation can be a positive for another
